purpose: Complete canonical REQ-SCOPE-097 over the real Song-suggestion objects by extending the already-shipped SuggestionDeferralMemory from Later this Song to all five accepted Not Now horizons, preserving one durable ledger and reversible append-only history.

lineage.outcome: The artist can defer a real Song suggestion for Later this Song, After release, Next Song, Someday, or Never suggest again; N0TE remembers the choice durably, applies it during service selection, and lets the artist restore it without deleting history.
lineage.capability: Five-horizon durable reversible suggestion deferral in one canonical profile ledger

why_now: The user explicitly selected real Song suggestions -> durable Not Now over those real objects -> continue SONG-01 -> global reselection. PR #80 proved only Later this Song. Canonical N0TE_PRODUCT_DB REQ-SCOPE-097 retains all five horizons, so the accepted requirement remains partially implemented. PR #77 proved the broader semantics but used a competing ledger and is superseded; this lane reuses and evolves the shipped canonical SuggestionDeferralMemory instead.

reuse.migration_required: lossless SuggestionDeferralMemory schema v1 to v2

implementation_contract.history: append-only DEFER and RESTORE events; no destructive deletion
implementation_contract.later_this_song: exact originating Song plus current work Session
implementation_contract.next_song: suppressed only while originating Song remains current
implementation_contract.after_release: suppressed while originating Song remains current until exact explicit release evidence for that Song is supplied; no inferred release state
implementation_contract.never_suggest_again: Artist-scoped until explicit restore; durable does not mean irreversible
implementation_contract.selection: CreativeSuggestionService itself excludes applicable deferred semantic keys and fails closed if every candidate is deferred
implementation_contract.compatibility: when no applicable deferral exists, existing deterministic suggestion selection remains unchanged
implementation_contract.authority: deferral changes Attention/suggestion visibility only and grants no provider, mutation, spend or publication authority

completion_proof: all five canonical horizons are durable and consumer-reachable over real suggestion semantic keys
existing v1 Later-this-Song rows migrate losslessly to v2 without a second database or semantic ledger
Later this Song expires when the work Session changes
Next Song stops applying on a different Song
After release fails closed until exact originating-Song release evidence and ignores unrelated release evidence
Someday and Never suggest again are Artist-scoped
restore appends history and makes the suggestion eligible again without deleting the original decision
applicable deferrals alter CreativeSuggestionService selection rather than merely hiding rendered HTML
Host, Origin, CSRF, one-shot and current Song/suggestion bindings remain enforced
semantic keys remain hidden from normal consumer markup
no AI/provider call, DAW mutation, spend/publication authority or taste-personalization claim is added
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass on Linux, Windows and macOS at the exact implementation head

evidence_snapshot.execution_note: Authored implementation and migration proof exist on PR #82; exact-head governed cross-platform execution is pending.

non_scope: Song release-state persistence or distribution workflow

next_selection_rule: After exact-head closure, return UX-01 to PRESERVED and continue the explicitly user-selected SONG-01 step. Only after that bounded SONG-01 continuation closes perform global dependency-ready reselection.
